svg.text: PR #412 · Retry failed webhook deliveries with exponential backoff
A webhook delivery that got a 5xx or timed out was dropped after one attempt;
now deliver() schedules a RetryJob with 1 s → 5 min backoff, so outages don't lose events.
logged at WARN; nothing re-enqueues it

g.text: customer must replay from the audit log by hand
attempt counter stored on the Delivery row
idempotency key = event.id → safe to redeliver
≤ 8 attempts over ~21 min, then dead-letter — never silent

svg.text: Does not preserve ordering: a retried event can arrive after newer events for the same subscriber.

svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.text: PR #418 · Acquire the cache lock before invalidating
Two writers could race between cache.delete() and the DB commit, pinning a stale value;
now invalidate() holds cache.lock(key) through commit, so no reader repopulates a pre-commit row.
cache holds old, DB holds new
nothing invalidates again until the next write

g.text: Stale read for the rest of the TTL
up to 1 h of wrong data after every concurrent write
Lock is best-effort with a 5 s TTL
CACHE_LOCK_TTL = 5 — a crashed writer cannot wedge readers
Readers repopulate only from committed rows
no stale window; writers hold the lock ~2 ms longer

svg.text: Does not cover multi-key invalidation: callers touching several keys still lock and commit them one at a time.

svg.text: PR #423 · Shorten session TTL to 24 h with sliding refresh
Session tokens lived 30 days from issue regardless of use, so a leaked token stayed valid for weeks;
now TTL is 24 h and refresh_session() extends it on activity, so idle tokens die within a day.
owner stopped using it on day 2

g.text: Leaked or forgotten tokens stay valid for weeks
revocation needs a manual DELETE FROM sessions
refresh_session() bumps it on each request

svg.text: a leaked idle token dies in ≤ 24 h
active users never notice: each request slides the window

g.text: sliding refresh cannot extend a session past 7 days from issue
Idle sessions expire within a day
leaked tokens lose value fast; active users stay signed in

svg.text: Does not revoke tokens issued before the deploy: existing 30-day sessions age out naturally over the following month.

svg.text: PR #431 · Validate upload manifests before enqueueing
Malformed manifests were accepted at POST /uploads and only failed inside the worker, hours later;
now validate_manifest() runs in the request, so callers get a 422 naming the field instead of a stall.

g.text: json.loads(body) → enqueue(ManifestJob) with no schema check

svg.text: size may be negative, or a string
checksum never matched against a sha256 pattern
errors surface as KeyError in ManifestWorker.run()
failure discovered ~3 h later, in the worker

g.text: Bad upload silently stalls until the worker dies
no field, no reason, nothing for the client to fix
content_type check skipped until 2026-12-01, then hard-fail

svg.text: Structural only: it does not verify the checksum against the uploaded bytes — ManifestWorker still does that later.

svg.text: PR #437 · Stream CSV exports instead of buffering them in memory
export_csv() built the whole file in a StringIO, so a 2M-row report needed ~1.8 GB and got OOM-killed;
now rows stream through StreamingHttpResponse in 5k-row chunks, so memory stays flat at ~40 MB.

g.text: every row materialised before the first byte

svg.text: 2M rows ≈ 1.8 GB against a 2 GiB pod limit

g.text: export dies after ~90 s with no partial output
server-side cursor; nothing held up front
Flat ~40 MB RSS regardless of row count
first bytes in < 200 ms; 2M rows complete in ~70 s

svg.text: An error mid-export now yields a truncated file with a 200 status; clients must check the trailing row-count line.
